name: Harar Jugol, the Fortified Historic Town
description: Harar Jugol is a walled hilltop city in eastern Ethiopia, about 500 km from Addis Ababa. Its maze of narrow lanes holds 82 mosques, three of them from the 10th century, and 102 shrines, and many call it the fourth holiest city of Islam. Its walls date from the 13th to 16th centuries, and its beautifully decorated townhouses are the highlight for visitors.
